document_metadata.doc_version_provenance: concept_docs_current_only_aligned_via_api_ref: GitHub latest release v1.19.0 != target 1.18 -> versioned URL form v-1-18-x used (Step 1.5 qdrant rules). API contract (endpoints, parameter schemas, enums, ranges) taken from the versioned v-1-18-x OpenAPI shards + api-reference pages (strictly version-aligned); concept docs (qdrant.tech/documentation/...) have NO version archive and were fetched at current (site latest, restructured layout: concepts/collections -> manage-data/collections, concepts/points -> manage-data/points, concepts/vectors -> manage-data/vectors, concepts/payload -> manage-data/payload, concepts/indexing -> manage-data/indexing, concepts/search + documentation/search -> search/search, concepts/filtering -> search/filtering, concepts/hybrid-queries -> search/hybrid-queries); used as behavioral/semantic corroboration only - on conflict the versioned spec wins. Local v1.18.0 server runtime probes corroborate: GET / -> version 1.18.0 commit db3fca327851e360c521065649e0f65a57fe7d3c, /readyz -> 200 'all shards are ready', /livez -> 200 'healthz check passed'. constraint text cites concept-doc pages inline via [DOC <page>] tags; api-reference URLs in endpoint records are the version-aligned per-endpoint source.

document_sources.content: collection data model, create/update/delete semantics, params
search params in detail, pagination semantics

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: query: min 1; seconds to wait before timeout

parameters.name: vectors

type: vectors.size is uint64 integer; vectors.distance enum [Cosine, Euclid, Dot, Manhattan]; sparse vector distance is always Dot (not user-settable) [DOC vectors]
range: HnswConfig.m >= 0 (create schema); HnswConfig.ef_construct >= 4; full_scan_threshold >= 0 (HnswConfig) / >= 10 (HnswConfigDiff); scalar quantization quantile expected in [0.5, 1.0]; strict_mode max_resident_memory_percent in [1,100]; ProductQuantization compression enum [x4,x8,x16,x32,x64]; ScalarQuantization type enum [int8]; BinaryQuantization encoding enum [one_bit, two_bits, one_and_half_bits]; datatype enum [float32, uint8, float16, turbo4]; turbo4 only for dense vectors [DOC vectors]
state: creating an existing collection name fails (409 observed family; spec: 4xx); Cosine normalizes vectors on upload (by-design) [DOC collections]
behavioral: 200 on success; 400 with JSON format error on invalid enum (runtime observed: `Format error in JSON body: data did not match any variant of untagged enum VectorsConfig`, HTTP 400, on distance:"Bogus"); 404 not applicable; timeout >= 1 else rejected

expected_responses.4xx: validation error (400) — invalid vectors config, invalid enum value, malformed JSON; 409-conflict family — collection already exists

api_endpoints.endpoint_name: Get Prometheus metrics of the service

behavioral: GET /metrics returns Prometheus-formatted metrics text (content-type text/plain) describing collections, searches, points, optimizations and cluster state; metric names documented on the docs site (metrics page).

api_endpoints.endpoint_name: Get telemetry data of the service

type: response TelemetryData {id, app, collections, cluster, requests, memory, hardware, search_pool, quota}
behavioral: internal/ops-oriented endpoint; 200 with full telemetry detail

api_endpoints.endpoint_name: Get current write protection lock state
Set write protection: blocks all mutation APIs with error_message

state: write=true blocks all mutation APIs, returning the configured error_message on any write attempt; used for maintenance windows

behavioral: 200 returns current node-wide quota configuration (1.18 node-wide quotas replace deprecated strict-mode max_resident_memory_percent)

api_endpoints.endpoint_name: Set node-wide quota config (replaces deprecated strict-mode max_resident_memory_percent)

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: default false; limits enforced only when true

type: body QuotaConfig {enabled (boolean, default false), max_resident_memory_percent (integer|null), max_disk_usage_percent (integer|null), release_margin_percent (integer|null)}
range: max_resident_memory_percent and max_disk_usage_percent bounded [1,100]; release_margin_percent bounded [0,100]; null means the resource is not capped
state: limits are enforced only while enabled=true; in v1.18 this node-wide config supersedes the deprecated collection-level strict_mode max_resident_memory_percent

data_types.name: PointId (ExtendedPointId)
data_types.description: oneOf 64-bit unsigned integer | UUID string; in every request a UUID string can be used instead of a numeric ID [DOC manage-data/points]

data_types.name: Dense vector
data_types.description: fixed-length array of floats (default float32); dimension must match the collection's configured size; Cosine distance auto-normalizes vectors on upload [DOC manage-data/collections]

data_types.name: Datatype enum
data_types.description: float32 (default) | float16 | uint8 | turbo4; uint8 dense vectors hold integers in range 0-255; turbo4 is 4-bit (TurboQuant), dense-only, cannot be configured for sparse vectors [DOC manage-data/vectors]

data_types.name: Sparse vector
data_types.description: {indices: [uint], values: [float]} - no fixed length, dynamically allocated; non-zero values limited to u32 range (4294967295); distance is always Dot (not user-settable) [DOC manage-data/vectors]

data_types.name: Multivector
data_types.description: matrix of same-shaped dense vectors; fixed length (dim) per row, variable count per point; requires multivector_config with comparator (enum: max_sim); MaxSim returns a single combined score per point [DOC manage-data/vectors]

data_types.name: Named vectors
data_types.description: multiple vectors per point keyed by name; each has its own size/distance/datatype; `using` selects which vector a query targets [DOC manage-data/vectors + search/search]

data_types.name: Payload JSON types (filterable)
data_types.description: integer (64-bit, i64 bounds), float (64-bit), bool, keyword (string), geo ({lon, lat} doubles), datetime (RFC 3339), uuid; arrays of same-type values supported - filter succeeds if at least one value matches [DOC manage-data/payload]

data_types.name: Filter
data_types.description: {should?, min_should?, must?, must_not?} - clauses recursively nestable to express arbitrary boolean expressions [DOC search/filtering]

data_types.name: Condition
data_types.description: oneOf: FieldCondition {key, match|range|geo_bounding_box|geo_radius|geo_polygon|values_count|is_empty|is_null}, is_empty, is_null, has_id ([PointId]), has_vector (named-vector presence), slice {slice: {of, total}}, nested {key, filter}, raw Filter (recursion) [DOC search/filtering]

data_types.name: Match
data_types.description: oneOf: value (string|int64|bool), text, text_any, phrase, prefix (byte-wise, case-sensitive), any (IN), except (NOR) [DOC search/filtering]

data_types.name: Range condition
data_types.description: {lt?, gt?, gte?, lte?} numbers; datetime ranges support RFC 3339 values [DOC search/filtering]

data_types.name: Geo conditions
data_types.description: GeoBoundingBox {top_left:{lon,lat}, bottom_right:{lon,lat}}; GeoRadius {center:{lon,lat}, radius in meters}; GeoPolygon {exterior:{points:[GeoPoint]}, interiors?} [DOC search/filtering]

data_types.name: ValuesCount
data_types.description: {lt?, gt?, gte?, lte?} each min 0 - matches arrays by element count [DOC search/filtering]

data_types.name: is_empty / is_null
data_types.description: is_empty matches a field that is missing OR null OR []; is_null matches a field that exists with null value; NULL cannot be tested via match [DOC search/filtering]

data_types.name: nested condition
data_types.description: key points to an array of objects ("data" or "data[]"); filter applies per array element; the parent point matches if at least one element matches; has_id and slice are NOT supported inside nested - place them in an adjacent must clause [DOC search/filtering]

data_types.name: Dot-notation field access
data_types.description: nested object access via "country.name"; arrays via "diet[].food" [DOC search/filtering]

data_types.name: SearchParams
data_types.description: hnsw_ef (min 1), exact (default false), quantization {rescore, oversampling}, indexed_only (default false), acorn {acorn_scale 0.0-1.0, default 0.4, disabled by default}, idf (global|local) [DOC search/search]

data_types.name: WriteOrderingType
data_types.description: weak | medium | strong (weak default; weak may reorder writes)

data_types.name: ReadConsistencyType
data_types.description: majority | quorum | all, or an integer N (number of replicas queried)

data_types.name: Memory placement enum
data_types.description: cold | cached | pinned (1.18) - replaces deprecated on_disk / always_ram booleans; pinned is not supported for dense vector storage (VectorParams.memory note) [SPEC]

schema: Collection config (resolved; GET /collections/{name}; v1.18.0 runtime-verified defaults [RT]): params.vectors: {size, distance} or named map; VectorParams required size (uint64), distance enum [Cosine, Euclid, Dot, Manhattan]; optional datatype, memory, multivector_config, hnsw_config, quantization_config, on_disk (deprecated). params.sparse_vectors: map {name: SparseVectorParams {index?: SparseIndexParams {memory, datatype}}}. params.shard_number (default 1), replication_factor (default 1), write_consistency_factor (default 1), on_disk_payload (default true in v1.18.0 standalone), payload (payload memory-tier config, new in 1.18). hnsw_config defaults: m=16, ef_construct=100, full_scan_threshold=10000 (KB), max_indexing_threads=0 (auto), on_disk=false; optional payload_m (min 0), inline_storage (default false), memory (default cached). optimizer_config defaults: deleted_threshold=0.2 (range 0-1), vacuum_min_vector_number=1000 (min 100), default_segment_number=0, max_segment_size=null (min 1 KB), memmap_threshold=null, indexing_threshold=10000 (KB, min 0; below this threshold vectors stay in plain index - small collections may have NO HNSW segment by design), flush_interval_sec=5, max_optimization_threads=null, prevent_unoptimized=null. wal_config defaults: wal_capacity_mb=32 (min 1), wal_segments_ahead=0 (min 0), wal_retain_closed=1 (min 0). quantization_config: null by default; Scalar {type: int8, quantile [0.5, 1.0]}, Product {compression x4|x8|x16|x32|x64}, Binary {encoding one_bit|two_bits|one_and_half_bits, query_encoding default|binary|scalar4bits|scalar8bits}. strict_mode_config (1.18): optional collection-level guardrails (enabled, max_query_limit, max_timeout, unindexed_filtering_retrieve/update, search_max_hnsw_ef, search_allow_exact, search_max_oversampling, upsert_max_batchsize, search_max_batchsize, max_collection_vector_size_bytes, read_rate_limit, write_rate_limit, max_collection_payload_size_bytes, max_points_count, filter_max_conditions, condition_max_size, multivector_config, sparse_config, max_payload_index_count, max_resident_memory_percent (deprecated, removal scheduled 1.21; node-wide replacement PUT /quotas)); metadata: arbitrary collection-level key-value metadata (1.18). Collection semantics: all vectors within one collection share the same dimensionality per vector name [DOC manage-data/collections]; creation body only accepts vector-space-defining properties (size/distance for dense); index/quantization/disk config applied or changed afterward via PATCH update [DOC manage-data/collections]. Indexable payload schema per field: PayloadSchemaType + per-type params (see index+create); index displayed via collection info payload_schema. Vector data model: dense vectors stored per collection (unnamed or named); sparse vectors have their own params; multivectors require comparator config; memory placement cold|cached|pinned [DOC manage-data/vectors].
